entries.dialogueText: "Tell me, Your Majesty, what do you think happens the moment you allow 'free press' to operate unchecked?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I oppose it because I know what wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I oppose it because I know what will follow it. Permit the media to criticize you, and the RPP will only be the first to jump at the opportunity."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Mock all you like, but it won't be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mock all you like, but it won't be so funny when their words start carrying more weight than ours."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I've also seen what happens when r..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've also seen what happens when rulers mistake concessions for control."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.dialogueText: "It matters if the *gift* you're giving them will one day be used to tear down the Crown."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Not everyone is a radical or demag..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not everyone is a radical or demagogue, Hugo. But if we silence them completely, it will only grow the radicalism more. Let's listen instead of suppressing them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A King who cannot face criticism i..."
entries.dialogueText: "A King who cannot face criticism is no King at all. I must take the risk."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""This is a dangerous game, Romus. B..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is a dangerous game, Romus. But one you seem eager to play."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He shook his head slightly. After a..."
entries.dialogueText: He shook his head slightly. After a brief pause, he nodded.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""If that's the path you're set on,..."
entries.dialogueText: "If that's the path you're set on, then so be it."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I see...""
entries.dialogueText: "I see..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And now you're pushing this propos..."
entries.dialogueText: "And now you're pushing this proposal..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Even if that's the case, your word..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even if that's the case, your words offered them hope, and made the nobility uneasy."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You didn't just support the moveme..."
entries.dialogueText: "You didn't just support the movement, but validated it. The nobility is very concerned about this."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I am worried that this will antago..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am worried that this will antagonize our fellow Houses against you -- and what you're trying to do..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I gave him the unsigned decree and..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""So tell me, if I am to stand besid..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.dialogueText: "This is for the best."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Good."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Fine. I will speak of this no more.""
entries.dialogueText: "Fine. I will speak of this no more."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""This decree is an invitation to th..."
entries.dialogueText: "This decree is an invitation to the radicals and demagogues to undermine you in broad daylight."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Rash? I am the Grand Vizier, Romus..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rash? I am the Grand Vizier, Romus. Your uncle. If I cannot question your path, then who can?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I ignored him and took a look at th..."
entries.dialogueText: I ignored him and took a look at the decree.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I serve this House and this throne..."
entries.dialogueText: "I serve this House and this throne, as I always have. I do not need to prove that to you."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It is not just the Houses, Romus.""
entries.dialogueText: "It is not just the Houses, Romus."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You make it sound like charity. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "You make it sound like charity. I prefer to think of it as balance. Let them vent, let them shout. It's easier to rule those who believe they still have choices."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Their democracy was a shadow play...."
entries.dialogueText: "Their democracy was a shadow play. I simply turned on the lights."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I just removed a liability. Now th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I just removed a liability. Now the people can truly speak their minds, not just repeat the words of their puppetmasters."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's precisely the plan.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's precisely the plan."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So, you approve of it?""
entries.dialogueText: "So, you approve of it?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So, this time you're not here to w..."
entries.dialogueText: "So, this time you're not here to warn me?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Power has never been about volume...."
entries.dialogueText: "Power has never been about volume. They can shout all they want in the papers, as long as they remember by whose grace they are printed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Exactly. And what is your opinion..."
entries.dialogueText: "Exactly. And what is your opinion on this matter?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And what would you have me do inst..."
entries.dialogueText: "And what would you have me do instead, Hugo? Silence them entirely?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Have you not seen the growing refo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have you not seen the growing reform movement? We have to give something back to the people to calm the situation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Have you not seen the unrest on th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have you not seen the unrest on the streets? We have to give something back to the people to calm the situation."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It's a bold move indeed. But I dis..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a bold move indeed. But I disagree that we *have to*.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It's a bold move.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's a bold move."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""No. I think it's a bold move.""
entries.dialogueText: "No. I think it's a bold move."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""A bold move, indeed.""
entries.dialogueText: "A bold move, indeed."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""They lose their loudest voices, bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "They lose their loudest voices, but gain some in the papers. You're giving them the illusion of power, while keeping it away from them."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""They lose their voice in governmen..."
entries.dialogueText: "They lose their voice in government, but gain some in the papers. You're giving them the illusion of power, while keeping it away from them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A little chaos, perhaps. A few ang..."
entries.dialogueText: "A little chaos, perhaps. A few angry columns, a few smug intellectuals thinking they've won something."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Perhaps so.""
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps so."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let me guess. You believe the stre..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let me guess. You believe the streets will rise and the monarchy will crumble overnight. Or, perhaps, people will just read the news over breakfast and carry on with their lives."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What happens? We let people speak...."
entries.dialogueText: "What happens? We let people speak. That's all. Not every decision is a step toward revolution, Hugo."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Illusions can be useful in times o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Illusions can be useful in times of growing radicalism. Let them believe they have a voice. It costs me nothing, and it hopefully keeps them from demanding more."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Of course they'll be antagonized...."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course they'll be antagonized. They were antagonized the moment I was crowned and refused to be their puppet."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You didn't protest when I got rid..."
entries.dialogueText: "You didn't protest when I got rid of Mr. Sotelato, now, did you?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The movement grew radical because..."
entries.dialogueText: "The movement grew radical because I followed your advice to get rid of Mr. Sazon."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are long past that stage. We're..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are long past that stage. We're already losing control over the streets."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The House of Delegates is already..."
entries.dialogueText: "The House of Delegates is already abolished, Hugo. This isn't helpful."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I see your point.""
entries.dialogueText: "I see your point."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Neither is truly controllable, Hug..."
entries.dialogueText: "Neither is truly controllable, Hugo. But I can still guide what's happening."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Giving them a platform to rant ins..."
entries.dialogueText: "Giving them a platform to rant instead of going out to the streets *is* control."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Perhaps so.""
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps so."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You are right.""
entries.dialogueText: "You are right."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I know.""
entries.dialogueText: "I know."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Yes. I...""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. I..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He sighed."
entries.dialogueText: He sighed.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Just think about it. This would be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just think about it. This would be an invitation to radicals and demagogues to undermine you in broad daylight."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But I didn't think you'd now give..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I didn't think you'd now give them the chance to reveal to everyone how the Crown moved against their leader."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""A bold idea. But...""
entries.dialogueText: "A bold idea. But..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But I still think this will be an..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I still think this will be an invitation to the radicals and demagogues to undermine you in broad daylight."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As if I could keep you from doing..."
entries.dialogueText: "As if I could keep you from doing so."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ironically, no. I don't want to he..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ironically, no. I don't want to hear your opinion on this subject. I've already made up my mind."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""On the contrary, this is about giv..."
entries.dialogueText: "On the contrary, this is about giving citizens the illusion of power while keeping them under our control."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Your words in public were... caref..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your words in public were... careful. But you offered them hope, and made the nobility uneasy."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You're too young to remember the V..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're too young to remember the Voice of Rizia. But I do."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Its writers didn't only attack the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Its writers didn't only attack the King's policies. They went after his personal life... even his family members."
